choose.otherwise: (t.task_level='month' and t.period between #{monthStart} and #{monthEnd}) or (t.task_level='week' and exists(select 1 from lab_task parent where parent.id=t.parent_id and parent.task_level='month' and parent.period between #{monthStart} and #{monthEnd} and parent.del_flag='0'))

mapper.sql: t.id as id,#{period} as period,t.period as taskPeriod,t.biz_line as bizLine,t.title as title,t.owner_id as ownerId,t.owner_id as owner,owner_user.nick_name as ownerName,t.task_level as taskLevel,t.plan_date as planDate,t.workflow_status as status,t.result_status as resultStatus,t.deliverable as deliverable,t.fail_reason as failReason,t.next_action as nextAction,t.current_block_flag as block
mapper.select: select from lab_task t left join lab_member owner_member on owner_member.id=t.owner_id and owner_member.del_flag='0' left join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner_member.user_id and owner_user.del_flag='0' where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW','CONFIRMED') and () order by t.plan_date,t.id

select from lab_task t left join lab_member owner_member on owner_member.id=t.owner_id and owner_member.del_flag='0' left join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner_member.user_id and owner_user.del_flag='0' where t.del_flag='0' and (t.result_status='UNDONE' or t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW')) and () order by t.plan_date,t.id

select from lab_task t left join lab_member owner_member on owner_member.id=t.owner_id and owner_member.del_flag='0' left join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner_member.user_id and owner_user.del_flag='0' where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{nextPeriod} order by t.plan_date,t.id

select ,t.coordination_content as coordination,t.coordination_support as coordinationSupport from lab_task t left join lab_member owner_member on owner_member.id=t.owner_id and owner_member.del_flag='0' left join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner_member.user_id and owner_user.del_flag='0' where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW') and t.coordination_required='1' and () order by t.plan_date,t.id

select ,b.block_type as blockType,b.block_reason as blockReason,b.block_start_time as blockStartTime from lab_task t join lab_task_block_event b on b.task_id=t.id and b.block_status='OPEN' and b.del_flag='0' where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW') and () order by b.block_start_time,t.id

select #{period} as period,t.workflow_status as status,t.result_status as resultStatus,count(1) as total from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW','CONFIRMED') and () group by t.workflow_status,t.result_status order by t.workflow_status,t.result_status

select a.id as id,a.asset_no as assetNo,a.asset_name as assetName,a.asset_type as assetType,a.asset_stage as assetStage,a.primary_owner_id as ownerId,a.backup_owner_id as backupOwnerId,a.critical_flag as criticalFlag,a.status as status,backup_member.member_status as backupOwnerStatus from lab_asset a left join lab_member primary_member on primary_member.id=a.primary_owner_id and primary_member.del_flag='0' left join lab_member backup_member on backup_member.id=a.backup_owner_id and backup_member.del_flag='0' where a.del_flag='0' and a.status='ACTIVE' order by a.asset_type,a.asset_no,a.id

select i.id as id,i.ipr_no as iprNo,i.ipr_name as iprName,i.ipr_type as iprType,i.ipr_stage as iprStage,i.owner_id as ownerId,i.planned_submit_date as plannedSubmitDate,i.actual_submit_date as actualSubmitDate from lab_ipr i where i.del_flag='0' and i.status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(i.actual_submit_date,i.planned_submit_date) between #{dateStart} and #{dateEnd} order by i.ipr_type,i.ipr_no,i.id

select p.member_id as memberId,p.period as period,p.revision_no as revisionNo,p.score as score,p.result_status as resultStatus,p.red_line_flag as redLineFlag,p.confirmation_status as confirmationStatus from lab_perf_score p left join lab_member m on m.id=p.member_id and m.del_flag='0' where p.del_flag='0' and p.current_flag='1' and p.period=#{performancePeriod} order by p.member_id,p.revision_no
